offering_description.value: The company sells medical products for pain treatment, fracture healing and orthopedic surgery. It develops and markets these products for healthcare professionals and their patients.

quotes.quote: Our mission is to partner with the health care community to deliver innovative medical devices and meet the evolving needs of patients, allowing them to resume and enjoy active lives. To this end, we develop and/or market clinically proven and cost-effective product offerings that are backed by clinical data. The products of Bioventus are known for their safety, innovation, and effectiveness.
The company focuses its medical product development around three segments: Pain Treatments, Restorative Therapies and Surgical Solutions.

primary_products.value: Osteoarthritis pain treatments; peripheral nerve stimulation devices; fracture-healing products; bone graft substitutes; ultrasonic surgical instruments

quotes.quote: The Pain Treatments and Joint Preservation products treat the chronic pain associated with osteoarthritis and peripheral nerve stimulation (PNS) products. These therapies relieve pain and help bring mobility back to the patient.

Our Surgical Solutions advance the science and surgical performance of biologics with a comprehensive portfolio of clinically efficacious and cost effective bone graft substitutes and a suite of minimally invasive therapeutic ultrasonic technologies optimized for hard and soft tissue removal.
